en: Maybe you've got a point.
It's got to be the mountains.

Mountains! Nice! Angelica shoots, fiddleheads,
and akebia! I love them all.
Those are all vegetables...

Cooking with ingredients you gathered yourself
is just one of the joys of the great outdoors.
It's got to be a pond.

Going outdoors to a pond?
Kind of plain, isn't it?

That's not true. It's nice to get out on a boat,
feed the birds, and just relax.

I see... A boat could be nice. You wouldn't even
have to go out too far. I never thought about it.

Relaxing is nice, but I prefer to get out
there and do something...

Although, it's not like I have anyone to take
me out right now...
Nope! I was in other clubs, though. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I like movies a lot, so I was in the film club.
That really takes me back. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Huh? Your Kazumundies? But I bet
they're all big and hard to wash.

I'd prefer it if you didn't
give my underwear strange nicknames.
Only if you help me, Kiryu-san.

You can boil the water, make the soup stock,
put in the miso, and cut the tofu.
What are you going to do, then?
I'll pour it!
Hey... Then it's just me making the soup.
<symbol=heart_with_outline> Did you catch me?
Whoa! You sounded like an old man all of a sudden!

I sing a lot of oldies, like stuff from the '70s.
Hard to sing them with a crowd my own age, though.
Huh. How about going with me, then?

Really? It does seem like you'd be in a better
age range for that. I'm excited now! <symbol=note_with_outline>

Dangerous men? I think I prefer people who
are more peaceful...

Wow, you hang around someone that crazy?
He sounds like a character out of a movie!

I'd like to meet him...
You should bring him by sometime.
You don't really want me to do that...

Wow, he gave you your first cell phone?
What a sweet guy.
Wow. This Akiyama-san ran a cabaret club, too?

You know all kinds of different people. If I ever
meet him, I'll have a ton of questions to ask.

Wow! He took down a bear!? We'll have to give
him a call if we ever get a bear in the club.
...I wouldn't worry about any bears waltzing in.
Wow, you know someone like that?
Yeah. I've known him since he was a kid.

We've been through a lot, but if we ever meet on
even ground, I'm sure the drinks would be great.

Male friendship is so wonderful...! When that day
comes, I'll get you a bottle of something nice.

I want to see Onomichi sometime.
Onomichi ramen... The fish are tasty, too.
Food really is all you think about, huh?
Kiryu-san! Sorry to keep you waiting. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Sorry! Did I make you wait?
Kiryu-san! I'm excited to see you again. <symbol=note_with_outline>
So, where should we go?
Karaoke, huh? Sounds good! <symbol=note_with_outline>
I don't normally play darts, but I'm excited!
Okay, let's go! <symbol=note_with_outline>
I wonder what you'll sing... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
What should I sing today? <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'm not so good, so go easy on me! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Okay, here I go!
Let's just focus on enjoying the rest, okay? <symbol=note_with_outline>
That was fun! We should come back soon. <symbol=note_with_outline>

That was so fun! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
We should definitely do this again sometime. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Shall we head back to the club?
This one's my specialty. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Oh, maybe I'll sing this one. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Hmm... I guess that song was too hard.
It was kinda hard to sing...
It was really fun to sing with you. <symbol=note_with_outline>

That song felt really good!
You're great at keeping the mood up! <symbol=note_with_outline>
I want to hear you sing something, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Aww... There's no need to be shy...
Oh... Uh... That was good...!
You're so good, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>

You sing incredibly well. <symbol=note_with_outline> I could listen
to you sing like that for hours on end. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Whoa! You've got deep pockets!
Oh, I like that one, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Thank you for waiting.
It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Hikaru.
Um, and your name is?
Oh. I'm Kiryu.

Kiryu-san? Well then, I look forward to spending some
time with you, Kiryu-san!
Yeah, same here.

Thank you for coming in today, Kiryu-san.
I enjoyed all the different topics! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Come back soon, won't you? <symbol=heart_with_outline>
And I'll be waiting. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Thanks for visiting me again, Kiryu-san.

Kiryu-san, welcome back.
I've been waiting for you. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Kiryu-san, welcome back.
I was hoping you'd come back again... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I'd like to spend more time
with you today. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Thank you for coming today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'll be waiting for your next visit.

Thank you for coming today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Come back soon. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Thank you for coming today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I hope to see you again soon... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Let's have some fun today. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Cheers! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Um, Kiryu-san!

Here, you can have my phone number.
Call me anytime you want, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>
It looks like our time's up.

We're out of time,
but I'd love to talk more...

I'm so happy! <symbol=note_with_outline>
You're the best, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Thank you so much for today! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Okay, got it! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Hmm, okay...
If you don't mind... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
No way.
That's not right at all!
What? You think so?
I'll pass. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Oh, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
That's top secret. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Um... Did you have fun talking
with me today, Kiryu-san?
What? Where's this coming from?

My customers are always telling me
I'm too quiet, or that I have no energy.
Oh. Well, you do seem pretty calm.

Lately, I've been wondering if a hostess
needs to be more upbeat and energetic.

I mean, the girls like that get more customers,
and they bring in more profit for the club.
That's what you're worried about?
Then, why don't we practice being energetic?
Huh? Practice?

Yeah, if you want to become your ideal self,
you have to put in the effort first.

You've gotta face the challenge head on, with
the knowledge that you can become better.

I see... I think you're right.
You mind if we give it a shot?
Yaaaaay!

Kiryu-san... I just can't do it... Wait,
did you trick me into this to tease me?
You got me...

Oh come on, Kiryu-san!
At least try to help me out!

Sorry, sorry. But it got you to be a
little more energetic, right?

You're right... Shoot.
You're better than I thought.

Well, you're fun to be with just as you
are. I don't think you need to force it.

Thank you. You're right.
I'll try to work on it in my own way.
Hikaru, I think you're fine as you are.

Not everyone comes to a cabaret club
expecting a wild party with energetic girls.

Some guys just want to have a drink with a
girl like you in a place they can relax.
Kind of like... me.
So, stay just the way you are.

There's nothing so wrong with you that you'd
need to hide who you really are, you know?

Kiryu-san... <symbol=heart_with_outline> Thank you so much.
I'm feeling really optimistic all of a sudden.

I'll work hard in my own, relaxed way. I hope
you'll keep coming to take it easy with me. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Yeah, of course.

If you're worried about something as silly as that,
how about I spend all my money to make you number one?

Huh!? Oh no, I could never. Please don't
waste your money on something like that.
But... then you'd be number one, yeah?

But... that doesn't feel right.
I want to aim for the top in my own way.

I thought you might say that.
Looks like you already have your answer.

I think you've gotta be yourself, Hikaru.
I like that, and that's why I requested you.

Kiryu-san... Thank you. You're right.
I shouldn't push myself too hard.

I'll work hard in my own, relaxed way! I hope
you'll come back and help me see it through.
Yeah. Give it your best shot.

Just curious, but, why'd you
decide to become a hostess?

I'm a student, so... I need to pay my tuition.
I'm paying my own way through school.
That's admirable.

Oh, not at all. I'm about to graduate,
so I really oughta be looking for a real job...
So, have you been?

No, actually... I have a dream...
I want to become an idol.
An idol?

Yeah... I've been looking into it a little
here and there, but it's not going anywhere...

I'm already 23... I should probably give
up on that and look for a real job, right?

I'm behind you all the way.
You shouldn't give up on your dreams.

Yeah. You only live once, so you've
gotta make your time count.

But, if you don't fully commit to it, you may
actually regret not giving up when you could have.

So... decide whether or not you're serious about
this, and make the call. If you are, I'm behind you.
Kiryu-san... Thank you.

Your words hit me really hard... Maybe I was
naive for even worrying over it.

I'll have to dig deep and give it some real thought.
If I do decide to go for it... I hope you'll root for me!
Of course. I'll be your first fan.
Yaaay! <symbol=heart_with_outline> I'll work hard at it!
Shouldn't you at least be looking?
So you think so too, huh?

Yeah. But I only feel that way because
I can tell you're being indecisive.

If you really want to make a dream come true,
you have to be determined to see it happen.

If you're hesitating now, then you may as well
give it up. Being an idol is no walk in the park.

But, if one day you can say from the bottom of
your heart that you want to be an idol, I'm behind you.

Everyone looks up to idols, and idols have to
shoulder those dreams. It's no walk in the park.

I actually know a former idol, and society and the
media can be both a blessing and a curse.

If you mess up, everything can come crashing down
in an instant. It's that strict, and you have to be strong.

So, I can't just casually say, yeah, go for it,
you have my support.

But, it's also the kind of job where your hard work and
determination pay off by giving people courage and smiles.

If you're ready to bear that burden...
Then I'm behind you all the way.

You're actually the first person who's taken it
that seriously and been honest about it. I'm so happy.

I... may have been a little naive. You can't aim
for something this hard half-heartedly.
I think I need to take a long, hard look in the mirror.

And I hope that one day I'll be able to tell you
that I want to become an idol with pride.
When you do, I'll be your first fan.

Okay! <symbol=heart_with_outline> I'll work so hard, you won't be able
to take your eyes off me!

So? Did you end up figuring out if you want
to look for a job or get into the idol thing?

Yes. I was actually thinking about
how I'd tell you that today.

I, Hikaru Shiota, hereby declare that
I'm going to try to become a top idol!
I thought you might.

Yeah! And if I don't seem serious,
I'm telling you, I'm quite serious!

And it's all thanks to your encouragement,
Kiryu-san. Thank you!

Hey, I just say whatever pops into my head.
Good luck with it.

Thanks! Though I still need to consider which
of my traits I want to emphasize.
Traits?

Yeah. Sorta like a catchphrase. If you don't set
yourself apart, you'll get lost in the crowd.
It's a competitive society we live in...

Yeah... So, Kiryu-san, do you have any
suggestions for a catchphrase that would fit me?
A catchphrase, huh... Let's see...
How about, "Check out my fine butt!"
Kiryu-san... You really get how this works!

I can't deny that my butt is part of my charm.
It might not be a bad idea to play that up!

That said, I'm impressed that you noticed.
That means you're staring at my butt a lot, huh?
No, all it took was a single glance...

Ohhhh, you. It's written all over your face.
You're cute when you're embarrassed.

How about, "I'm such a bright, energetic, and
sunny girl, that you'll need shades!"

Kiryu-san, you're pretty good at this...
That does sound like a catchphrase.

But I don't think I'm all that bright or
energetic, so, do you think that'll work?

Don't underestimate the power of words. If you
say you're bright and energetic, they'll believe it.

I see. So it's kind of like getting out in front of
my shortcomings? Amazing! You're like my producer.
